kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
اشمأززت (form IVq)
# اِشْمَأْزَزْتُ (išmaʔzaztu) /iʃ.maʔ.zaz.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
# اِشْمَأْزَزْتَ (išmaʔzazta) /iʃ.maʔ.zaz.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
# اِشْمَأْزَزْتِ (išmaʔzazti) /iʃ.maʔ.zaz.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
